newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia, Thailand seek better trade, investment.
newsitem.headline: Australia, Thailand seek better trade, investment.

text.p: Australia and Thailand will seek to foster increased trade and investment during top level talks beginning in Canberra on Wednesday, Australia said on Tuesday.

In the latest in a series of bilateral forums Australia has established with Asian countries, Canberra's foreign and trade ministers will meet Thailand's foreign and commerce ministers for two days of talks, Foreign Minister Alexander Downer said in a statement.
"The meeting will look for specific opportunities to increase two-way trade and investment," Downer said.
"Discussions will focus on issues of market access and impediments to bilateral commercial dealings, and also on education, development co-operation, tourism and trade promotion," he added.

Thai Foreign Minister Prachuab Chaiyasarn and Commerce Minister Narongchai Akrasanee will also discuss regional security and international free trade negotiations in their talks with Downer and Trade Minister Tim Fischer.
